tickets.text: Add: POSITION-system break (structure_shift BULLISH_BOS). The 'no buy past pivot +5%' clause is a swing-system never-buy-the-extension rule; the position entry is a buy stop over bar_high trailed to each new prior-day high (C26, C27, R10). Exit on a close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d) or a red candle sold next session under its low (C14, C29).

Add: POSITION-system break at the pivot (structure_shift BULLISH_BOS). The 'no buy past pivot +5%' clause is a swing-system rule; once the pivot breaks the buy stop trails each new prior-day high (C26, C27, R10). Exit on a close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d) or a red candle sold next session under its low (C14, C29).

Add: POSITION-system case at the pivot, W and D HH/HL. The 'no buy past pivot +5%' clause is a swing-system rule; once the pivot breaks the buy stop trails each new prior-day high (C26, C27, R10).
